name: @moonfin/build-clis
//: The build CLIs live here instead of in devDependencies. Both ship an npm-shrinkwrap.json that pins their whole dependency tree, and npm always honors it, so as normal dependencies those outdated pins land in the repo lockfile and raise Dependabot alerts we can't fix from here. Neither overrides nor npm audit fix can reach inside a shrinkwrap. This folder's node_modules and lockfile are git-ignored, which keeps the pins out of the repo. The root postinstall installs them through scripts/ensure-clis.js, and packages/cli-shim exposes their commands.
//enact-pin: @enact/cli stays on 7.2.1. 7.3.x bundles eslint-plugin-react-hooks 6, whose new rules flag 55 errors in packages/app and fail both the lint gate and enact pack. The legacy patcher itself works on 7.3.3, so upgrading just needs those findings fixed first.
